utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m still on for Saturday and can help with setup and sorting on the front porch. Just let me know if the plan changes again.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik. I’ll keep you posted if anything changes, and I’m glad you’re on setup and sorting for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Pia, quick update: the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’ll share the new details soon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, thank you for the update — Sunday at the community center is a big change. I’ll wait for the new details so I can adjust the setup and sorting plan.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That would be a huge help, Oren. Could you take the table setup and greet folks as they come by?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, Tess, I can do the table setup and greet folks on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I can help with setup and sorting supplies on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks, Uli — can you be on the front porch a little early to help set up?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, I can do that. I’ll help set up and hand out tools on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, great — I can help with that too. Just let me know what else you need me to do on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Rosa — 10 works great. I’ll see you at the front porch, and your help with greeting, sorting, and tools will make a big difference.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually, quick update — the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll send the new details soon, and I still appreciate your help!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Could you help with setup and sorting on the front porch this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that would help a lot — could you handle setup and sorting on the front porch this Saturday?
